The JoSAA Counselling 2026 process for admissions to IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs has officially commenced. This year, admissions to 23 IITs, 32 NITs, 26 IIITs, and 56 GFTIs will be conducted through JoSAA.
Students can register and fill their college and branch preferences from 2 June to 11 June. With access to 900+ programmes across 138 institutions, it is important to prepare a well-planned preference list based on your rank, interests, and previous years' opening and closing ranks.
Important Dates
• Choice Filling: 2–11 June

• Round 2: 30 June
• Round 3: 6 July

Students should keep all required documents ready, including Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, category certificates, medical certificate, and a cancelled cheque copy. EWS and OBC candidates must ensure their certificates are issued after 1 April 2026.
